pullRequest.title: fix: fence stale Claude suggestions and uncertain Codex samples
pullRequest.body: ## Problem Two opt-in prompt-suggestion paths can lose the identity or cancellation ownership of their original native work. Claude can restore A's suggestion slot after B was already accepted, and its wire event cannot identify a late A frame after B completes. Codex drops the sent sample's cancellation handle when its local RPC timeout expires, allowing later auxiliary work while the original sample remains unknown. ## Scope and current stage This isolated repair branch preserves all 43 commits and both Thinking changes through `9423f600dfb04d04448326dbced89919924b0b5f`. It does not move PR #8's shared head. The published R1 is §14 of `docs/plans/2026-11-14-native-next-prompt-suggestions.md`, commit `3ac086d1c157645faa358f0578f8dc764c950d66`. The current stage contains documentation only. Two additive finite-fixture test files come next. Both actual semantic REDs and independent source review are required before the bounded Claude Session and Codex app-server producer changes. The intended behavior is auxiliary-only lifetime quarantine for ambiguous Claude attribution and an unknown-sample latch plus at-most-once cancellation of Codex's original sent request. Ordinary inputs, readiness, queueing, deadlines, interactions and physical cleanup remain under their existing contracts. Suggestions remain default-off. ## Validation and boundaries Use the unchanged original `pnpm check` CI on Node 24.21.0 and 26.11.1 with pnpm 11.18.0, including both packed consumers. Earlier 9423 results—540 controlled passes and its checked archive pair—remain historical evidence and do not qualify the repair. Retain exact-head RED/GREEN logs and the newly checked archive pair before any separate atomic consumer adoption. Keep this PR Draft. The four original workflows were reviewed: safe CI is reachable; the Codex native job is Draft-skipped; Claude native and native OpenCode V2 paths do not match this bounded repair. No real Claude/Codex executable, SDK process, model request or version command; no manual dispatch, rerun, cancellation, native qualification or deadline extension. Product composer work and application archive/SPI adoption are outside this PR. --- ## Summary by cubic Fences stale Claude suggestions and uncertain Codex samples in the optional prompt-suggestion paths. Claude accepted-queue ordering can let a delayed earlier suggestion restore its slot after a successor was admitted, and the wire event has no input ID to disambiguate it. Codex local RPC expiry discards the only cancellation handle for a potentially sent sample, leaving unknown auxiliary work. - Claude: tracks the original suggestion owner; successor admission, interrupt, or uncertainty latches auxiliary offers off for the Query's lifetime, with no invented recovery criterion. - Codex: retains the sent sample's ID, latches auxiliary sampling on uncertain settlement, and attempts at most one targeted `thread/sample/cancel` while the transport is open. - Adds regression fixtures to `claude-sdk.test.ts` and `codex-subprocess.test.ts` plus the R1 plan documenting the defects and edit boundary. Suggestions remain default-off; no real Claude/Codex process is invoked. Written for commit c79b81bf002eaac95436da71c7049d7f309906a9. Summary will update on new commits.
